# Controlled story-adaptation benchmark fixtures

This directory contains synthetic benchmark-only content created for Panda Pages.

It is deliberately **not** a publication source and must not be treated as evidence that a work is eligible for the Panda Pages library. The manifest marks `publicationEligible` as `false`.

The fixtures exist only to exercise semantic adaptation validation. Each case uses the same synthetic canonical story and StoryAnalysis, then supplies structurally valid derived-edition Markdown with either a clean control or a deliberate semantic defect.

Real public-domain source benchmarking is a separate benchmark layer and must continue to use the Panda Pages source-eligibility pipeline.
